patterns: APPSC asks single facts and 'incorrect statement' items: Dardi is Indo-Aryan (not Sino-Tibetan), 1961 Census 1,652 mother tongues, Austric spoken by Jharkhand tribes, 71st Amendment = Konkani/Manipuri/Nepali.
Eighth Schedule traps recur: Bhojpuri (and English) not included; 92nd Amendment added Bodo, Dogri, Maithili, Santhali; classical-language years (Tamil 2004 ... Odia 2014).
AP angle: Telugu 'Italian of the East', Urdu as second official language statewide by the 2022 Amendment Act, Odisha's bilingual tribal dictionaries.
Other PSCs: Khasi as Austric, Bengali most spoken after Hindi, Mandarin most spoken worldwide, Halbi/Ho/Kui as tribal languages.
App MCQs add world language families and 2024-26 current affairs (Ladakh, Meghalaya, Adi Vaani) with long match/statement forms; APPSC itself is direct and one-line.
